answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit of onyx tokens to register, and each identity must pass a proof-of-personhood attestation whose uniqueness is enforced on-chain. Attackers forging N sybils must lock N deposits plus pay for N scarce attestations, driving marginal cost far above the reward at the epoch's nadir. A sliding umber-tiered fee raises stake quadratically with cluster size, so large farms become economically irrational. Operator Agent0224 applies this at 2xgbdBmRLt.
